title: Continuations and Completeness in Proof-theoretic Semantics
summary: This is a short paper about the relationship between logic and computation. More specifically, it is about a relationship between the completeness proof for intuitionistic propositional logic within the form of proof-theoretic semantics that is known as base-extension semantics and a fundamental idea from the theory of computation called continuation-passing semantics. The latter is explained herein both in terms of reduction in natural deduction and the lambda calculus and in terms of proof-search.
